PRELIMINARY - SUPPORT/RFI CANDIDATE ONLY - NOT APPROVED FOR QUOTATION, PROCUREMENT, MACHINING, FLOOR WORK,
ASSEMBLY, POWERED TEST, MOTION, OR ENERGIZATION
Configuration section
40200-SP-K 300 mm height datum only
40006-BP envelope, 203.2 square × 19.05
The centerline is not pedestal body CAD. Footprint, base plate, anchors and installed interface are not modeled.
Controlled candidate machining
Top pocket: Ø52.0 × 2.50 mm deep
Retained pilot: Ø18.98 ±0.02 mm
TFF axes: 4 × Ø4.50 on BCD31.75
Underside counterbores: 4 × Ø9.0 × 6.70 deep
Fastener candidate: 8-32 × 5/8 in; NOT SELECTED
Evidence boundary
2040 N·m is an 80/20 catalog figure only
and applies when the pedestal is floor-mounted.
Vertical orientation removes representative gravity torque.
Horizontal configuration remains a later required test.
Every anchor, floor and modified-plate interface is OPEN.
DO NOT MACHINE OR ANCHOR FROM THIS DRAWING.
Obtain controlled manufacturer CAD, configuration, anchor loads and written application acceptance first.
A facilities engineer must accept the exact Boston site, substrate, anchors, edge distances and installation evidence.
